data.narrative:
VVater, a seed-stage climate and energy company founded by Kevin Gast, has raised $5.79M to date. The comparable universe consists of 8 private peers in the Climate & Energy sector (including Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, Electric Hydrogen, and Enovix) plus 1 public comparable (LNZA), though the private peer set lacks sufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage datapoints for reliable median benchmarking.

The stage-progression method is the applicable triangulation approach. Using total raised ($5.79M, rounded to $6M) as a proxy for post-money valuation and applying a 2.5x step-up multiplier typical of seed-to-next-stage progression yields an implied valuation of $14.5M. This represents the median point across the analysis.

The valuation range supported by this analysis spans $12M (low) to $17M (high), with a median of $14M. The narrow methodological foundation—relying on a single applicable method rather than multiple independent triangulation points—represents the primary analytical constraint. Peer-median analysis could not be applied due to insufficient resolution within narrow stage and valuation-tier filters. Resolution of this uncertainty would require either: (i) access to same-stage or adjacent-stage private comparable financial performance data, or (ii) clarification of VVater's revenue, technology maturity, or capital deployment trajectory relative to the broader Climate & Energy peer set.
